headline: Trump seeks Russia deal to lower fuel costs
standfirst: The president is pushing for a new agreement to help lower gas prices ahead of the

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: President Trump is pursuing a deal involving Russia to help bring down fuel prices.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Rising fuel costs have created significant political pressure on the president.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Lowering prices could ease the strain on voters before the upcoming midterm elections.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Keep an eye on fuel price trends as the midterm elections approach next month.

caption:
President Trump is attempting to secure a deal with Russia to address rising fuel prices in the United States.

This move comes as the administration faces increasing political pressure to provide relief at the pump. The president hopes to ease this burden for his party before voters head to the polls next month.
